name: Houdini MCP: Production Memory
description: Records scene results, reviews, pattern usage, and failures into production memory. Also queries scene history, successful patterns, and failure patterns. Provides a persistent knowledge store that improves recommendations over time. No bridge calls, no mutations.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.production_memory import get_production_memory


class HouMCPProductionMemoryNode(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_production_memory"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",          "string", widget_type="text", default="stats")
        self.add_input("scene_data_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("scene_type",      "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("limit",           "int",    widget_type="int",  default=20)
        self.add_output("statistics",  "any")
        self.add_output("history",     "list")
        self.add_output("patterns",    "list")
        self.add_output("failures",    "list")
        self.add_output("record_id",   "string")
        self.add_output("result_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action      = (inputs.get("action") or "stats").strip().lower()
        raw_data    = (inputs.get("scene_data_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}"
        scene_type  = (inputs.get("scene_type") or "").strip() or None
        limit       = int(inputs.get("limit") or 20)

        try:
            scene_data = json.loads(raw_data) if isinstance(raw_data, str) else raw_data
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            self.log_error(f"scene_data_json parse error: {exc}")
            scene_data = {}

        mem = get_production_memory()
        record_id = ""
        history   = []
        patterns  = []
        failures  = []

        try:
            if action == "record_scene":
                record_id = mem.record_scene(scene_data)
                self.log_info(f"Recorded scene: {record_id}")

            elif action == "record_failure":
                record_id = mem.record_failure(scene_data)
                self.log_info(f"Recorded failure: {record_id}")

            elif action == "history":
                status = scene_data.get("status")
                history = mem.get_scene_history(scene_type=scene_type, status=status, limit=limit)
                self.log_info(f"Retrieved {len(history)} scene history records.")

            elif action == "successful_patterns":
                patterns = mem.get_successful_patterns(scene_type=scene_type, limit=limit)
                self.log_info(f"Retrieved {len(patterns)} successful patterns.")

            elif action == "failures":
                failures = mem.get_failure_patterns(scene_type=scene_type, limit=limit)
                self.log_info(f"Retrieved {len(failures)} failure records.")

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Production memory operation failed: {exc}")

        statistics = mem.get_statistics()
        result = {
            "action":     action,
            "statistics": statistics,
            "history":    history,
            "patterns":   patterns,
            "failures":   failures,
            "record_id":  record_id,
        }

        return {
            "statistics":  statistics,
            "history":     history,
            "patterns":    patterns,
            "failures":    failures,
            "record_id":   record_id,
            "result_json": json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str),
            "exec_out":    True,
        }


def register_node():
    return HouMCPProductionMemoryNode
